name: Sino Medical Sciences Technology Inc.
summary: Sino Medical Sciences Technology Inc., a medical device company, engages in the research, development, production, and distribution of interventional medical devices in China. Its products include coronary drug stents, coronary balloons catheter, intracranial rapid exchange balloons, and intracranial drug-eluting stents, as well as transapical mitral valve replacement system. Sino Medical Sciences Technology Inc. was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Tianjin, China.
